_doc: Plague in the streets (systems/plague.js, ui/innerMapPlague.js): how bad a town's sickness is (severityAt 0..1, from settlement.sickness — systems/illness.js — and the great plague's struck towns, systems/crises.js), its gates shut against travellers (per town: settlement.plagueGate, shut by its ruler or by the player who rules or holds it; Illness.quarantined reads it, so the sickness crosses less to the next towns and trade on its links is cut: systems/marketDynamics.js), and what the player can do in a sick town: nurse the sick in a marked house, burn a dead household's goods (the town's spread slowed a while), sell remedies at a plague price, loot a dead household's house (a crime, and the goods may carry it). State on the settlement (plagueGate, plague: saved with the tile).

severity._doc: 0..1. A plague: plagueBase + its sick share × plaguePerShare (at most 1); a great plague's struck town at least crisisFloor while its course runs. Another serious epidemic: epiBase + share × epiPerShare, at most epiMax; a serious sickness short of an epidemic: minorMax at most. A town with no roster keeps an abstract sickness: abstractPlague / abstractOther.

gates._doc: A town's ruler shuts its gates (AI): at a severity of closeAt or more, each week a roll of closeChance (always, where the realm's Pestilence law is quarantine); a plague town at closeAtPlague with plagueChance. They open again openAfterDays after the town is free of it (no severity), and not before minDays shut. A town the player rules (their realm) or holds (settlement.owner) is never shut for them: they are told, and choose (the Sick of the Town panel). The player is turned away at the gates (player/core/movement.js) unless permitted: they rule its realm, hold it, keep a house there, paid its physicians this month (folk.ill.fund by the player, or the crisis's physicians), or slipped the guards a bribe (bribe by town type; bribeDays the leave lasts; caught with bribeCaught: the crime 'smuggling' × bribeScale). happiness: the town's mood a week shut.

street._doc: On the street map (ui/innerMapPlague.js; world/innerMap/townSickness.js). stayHome: the healthy keep in (base + perSev × severity, at most max) each hour's pick. stallAbandon × severity: share of the square's stalls left with their wares under a cloth; shopShut × severity: share of the shops shuttered (no trade at them; world/innerMap/npcs.js) — never shuttered: neverShut. boardAt: from this severity the doors of the plague houses are boarded as well as crossed. bonfireAt: herb fires burn in the square (bonfires: at most); a dead household's goods burnt keep a fire before its door burnDays. doctorAt: the healers go masked (doctorLayers: their LPC look). pitDeaths: plague dead in pitDays for the open grave in the churchyard. abandon: of the houses no one lives in now, the share taken for a dead household's (× the plague dead of pitDays / 3, at most abandonMax). bellEvery: secs between the death cart's bell.

actions._doc: nurse: tend the sick laid up in a marked house — each one's care × careMult (as the healer's best), their regard + regard, karma once a house a day, mercy deeds. burn: a dead household's bedding and clothes on a fire before its door — the town's spread within its walls × cleanseMult for cleanseDays (systems/illness.js town contact), karma, mercy and piety deeds; once a house. remedies: medicines from the packs sold to the frightened (the townsfolk's purses, the fullest first) at the good's price × (premiumBase + premiumPerSev × severity), at most perDay a day; the remedy goes to a sick house (their care the better); above greedAt × the price it is profiteering (greed deeds, karma −1 a sale, the town remembers). loot: a dead household's house — what the dead left in their purses and the goods of the table (rolls on Utils' stream), the crime 'burglary' × crimeScale (seen at seenBase × (1 − severity × emptyStreets): caught heat, the town remembers 'robbed'); the goods may carry it: catch × severity of the plague ailment.

doctor: Stand back. The miasma clings to the living.
Vinegar and rue — breathe through it.
Burn the bedding. All of it.
gateTurn: Turn back! The gates are shut — no one in or out.
Not one step further. There's plague in the town.
The lord has closed the gates. Go round, stranger.
bonfire: Burn rosemary — it clears the air.
Keep the fires high, keep the miasma off.
looted: Someone's been in the Weavers' house... and them hardly cold.
nursed: You came in? Into this house? Gods keep you.
